text: At its meeting on December 4, 5, and 13, 2018, City Council amended the Public Appointments process by authorizing the City Clerk to shortlist, interview and recommend candidates to Community Councils for appointment to the Moss Park Arena Board.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed Chris Poirier as the Central Toronto Skating Club representative to the Moss Park Arena Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on April 23, 2023, and until a successor is appointed. 2. Directed Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (April 24, 2019) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Moss Park Arena Board.
